# Expected values: GoogleSQL compliance functions_testlib_format_numeric.cc;
# BigQuery documents NUMERIC formatting with %f, %t and %T.
# UNNEST prevents constant folding by the analyzer.

SELECT FORMAT('%t', x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> "99999999999999999999999999999.999999999"

SELECT FORMAT('%.11f', x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '99999999999999999999999999999.999999999']) AS x
=> "99999999999999999999999999999.99999999900"

SELECT FORMAT('%10.0f', x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-1.5']) AS x
=> "        -2"

SELECT FORMAT('%10.9f', x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '1.999999999']) AS x
=> "1.999999999"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '-3.14']) AS x
=> "NUMERIC \"-3.14\""

SELECT FORMAT('%t', x) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)]) AS x
=> "NULL"

SELECT FORMAT('%T', x) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)]) AS x
=> "NULL"

SELECT FORMAT('%f', x) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC)]) AS x
=> null

SELECT FORMAT(CAST(NULL AS STRING), x) FROM UNNEST([NUMERIC '3.14']) AS x
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FORMAT(f, NUMERIC '3.14') FROM UNNEST(['%s']) AS f
=> null

SELECT FORMAT(f, NUMERIC '3.14') FROM UNNEST(['%s']) AS f
=> error:
